progression.prerequisiteKnowledge: Reversible and irreversible reactions; particles are always moving; rate means how much changes per second (Year 11).
progression.startsWith: A sealed bottle of soda water that looks completely still.
progression.stopsAfter: Classifying systems as static, dynamic or neither and explaining why dynamic equilibrium needs a closed system.
progression.nextLesson: C2: how a reaction reaches equilibrium, rates changing over time.

teaching.task: Classify static, dynamic or neither, and explain the closed-system requirement.
teaching.causalExplanation: Opposing processes continue at equal rates so amounts stay constant; static means both rates are zero because the reaction finished; opening the system loses the returning half of the exchange.
teaching.conversationalApproach: Concrete sealed drink and campfire, two-towns traffic analogy, teacher-led three-question classification.
teaching.openingDecision: Has everything stopped in a still-looking sealed bottle?
teaching.understandingCheck: Classify a saturated salt jar, a cooling coffee and burned magnesium with reasons.
teaching.curriculumScope: Model static and dynamic equilibrium and analyse the differences between open and closed systems (CH12-12). Rate graphs deferred to C2.

design.visualSystem: Explainer engine: warm paper stage, handwritten Caveat headings, amber doodle layer, painted plates with coded molecule views.
design.transitionPlan: Lens zoom from bottle to molecules; crossfade sealed to open bottle pair; campfire burning to ash crossfade; scene crossfades with settle.

scenes.teachingReason: Sets a concrete puzzle before any terms
scenes.motionPurpose: Camera push builds curiosity on the still bottle
scenes.onScreenChange: Slow push in on the sealed bottle; heading writes on at "stopped"
scenes.holdPurpose: Brief look at the still bottle

scenes.visualReference: Explainer lens over the bottle surface with coded CO2 molecules
scenes.teachingReason: Shows both processes happening at once
scenes.narrationCue: escape / dissolve / exactly the same rate
scenes.motionPurpose: Molecules cross the surface in both directions while counters match
scenes.onScreenChange: Lens zooms in; molecules arc up on "escape" and down on "dissolve"; two equal live counters

scenes.visualReference: Two-towns traffic doodle and molecule view
scenes.teachingReason: Gives the term after the cause and a precise analogy
scenes.motionPurpose: Cars flow both ways at equal rate between unequal towns
scenes.onScreenChange: Term writes on with meanings; traffic doodle animates; aid writes on and is underlined
scenes.holdPurpose: Hold the aid "Equal rates, not equal amounts" to read

scenes.visualReference: c1 campfire burning and ash pair
scenes.teachingReason: Contrasts a finished irreversible reaction with dynamic exchange
scenes.motionPurpose: Fire burns down to ash and both rate gauges drop to zero
scenes.onScreenChange: Crossfade burning to ash on "ash"; two gauges fall to 0 on "zero"; cross on "slow"
scenes.holdPurpose: Hold the ash with both gauges at zero

scenes.visualReference: c1 bottle sealed and open pair plus molecule lens
scenes.teachingReason: Shows why an open system cannot reach equilibrium
scenes.narrationCue: cap off / flat / closed system / open system
scenes.motionPurpose: Returning molecules thin out while escaping ones leave the frame
scenes.onScreenChange: Bottle crossfades to open; escaping arcs leave frame; counters diverge; boundary line breaks

scenes.visualReference: Hand-drawn decision flowchart with iodine flask, ash and evaporating beaker plates
scenes.teachingReason: Teacher models the three-question classification on site examples
scenes.narrationCue: reversible / closed / staying constant / dynamic / static / neither
scenes.motionPurpose: A pen traces each case through the flowchart to a stamped verdict
scenes.onScreenChange: Flowchart diamonds build on each question; each case gets a traced path and verdict stamp

scenes.visualReference: Same flowchart with campfire ash and evaporating beaker plates
scenes.teachingReason: Applies the ordered questions to a static case and a neither case
scenes.motionPurpose: Ash traces straight to STATIC; beaker fails at Closed and lands on NEITHER
scenes.onScreenChange: First case shrinks to a chip; ash and beaker paths trace in turn with verdict stamps

scenes.visualReference: Salt jar, hot coffee and burned magnesium plates with small flowchart
scenes.teachingReason: Unseen transfer decision with all conditions visible
scenes.motionPurpose: Countdown ring runs through the quiet hold
scenes.onScreenChange: Three numbered vignettes appear as named; countdown ring starts after narration
scenes.holdPurpose: Quiet answer-free thinking hold with countdown

scenes.teachingReason: Explains each verdict and names the still-looks-stopped trap
scenes.motionPurpose: Each vignette gets its flowchart trace and verdict; salt pile zoom shows ions leaving and rejoining
scenes.onScreenChange: Verdict stamps in turn; small zoom into the salt pile with ions exchanging

scenes.teachingReason: Gives a reusable decision rule and the key aid
scenes.motionPurpose: Three rule lines write on with icons
scenes.onScreenChange: Rule lines write on in turn; aid repeated; next-lesson chip

scenes.motionPurpose: Notes appear then stay still for copying
scenes.holdPurpose: Quiet copy hold with pause invitation
